name: Regrouting vs Retiling a Shower: How to Tell Which You Need
title-tag: Regrouting vs Retiling a Shower | Lake Stevens Tile
meta-description: Cracked shower grout can mean a one-day regrout or failed waterproofing. How to read the symptoms, what an honest regrout involves, and when to retile.
post-summary: December 29, 2026 · Grout was never waterproof — so cracked grout can be a cheap cosmetic fix or the first visible symptom of a failed shower. Here is how to tell which one you have: the tap test, the repeat-failure rule, and the signs that say the problem is behind the tile. Plus what an honest regrout involves and when it just delays a rebuild.
